content:
Olivia P.: Hey team — first draft of the product rollout blog is in Google: https://docs.google.com/draft — can folks skim today? Need copy + approvals + webinar CTA mapping by EOD tomorrow.

Matt G.: on it. I'll check the latency/cost numbers for the bench section — want to make sure we don't over-claim.

Jason R.: Skimmed intro. I think the narrative needs a clearer customer problem at top, maybe a 2-sentence 'why now' that ties to reduced token cost.

Olivia P.: good call, Jason. @Jason R. can you propose 2 variants? one short, one longer we can test in A/B.

Jason R.: will do. short: "Serve LLMs faster, cheaper — without rebuilding infra." longer: "Teams can ship features faster by offloading inference complexity to a single runtime that optimizes latency and cost."

Tara L. (Legal): quick flag — any explicit % savings claims? If we include numbers, need source and safe phrasing (e.g., "up to"). Also avoid naming competitor models by brand.

Matt G.: We measured median token cost reduction ~27% on internal benchmarks vs baseline config. We can portray as "~25%" or "up to 30% depending on workload". I'll attach the benchmark spreadsheet later.

Olivia P.: Perfect. Use the safer wording Tara suggested.

Sophia K.: For the webinar CTA: we want registrants funneled into the 'Redwood Launch - Product' HubSpot list and tagged by role (eng, product, infra). Can we add form field mapping?

Emma D.: Hero image note: current hero concept is a stacked rack + waveform. I can produce two variants: abstract (stylized GPU rack) and product UI (console screenshot). Which do you prefer for launch?

Olivia P.: Lean abstract for the public post, UI screenshot for gated webinar landing. @Emma D. please export 1200x628 and 800x420.

Nate (SEO): SEO notes: title should be <= 65 chars. Suggest: "Redwood Inference: Predictable LLM Serving for Production" Meta desc ~ 155 chars; include keywords "LLM inference", "low latency", "cost optimization". I'll do a quick keyword pass after the copy is finalized.

Olivia P.: thanks Nate. Also: we need the CTA matrix for the post and webinar. Proposing: 1) Blog CTA — Read more + Join webinar (link) 2) Webinar landing — Register (form + role field) 3) Post gated assets — Request demo (route to AE flow).

Sophia K.: For HubSpot form fields I'll paste mapping here:
```
form_id: 2384-launch
fields:
  - email -> contact.email
  - first_name -> contact.firstName
  - last_name -> contact.lastName
  - role -> contact.jobTitle
  - company -> contact.company
  - use_case -> contact.rr_use_case
tags: ["launch-product", "webinar-march"]
```
Also please add hidden field: utm_campaign=product_rollout_march

Olivia P.: great, @Sophia K. can you drop the form embed snippet we should use? also we need to confirm GDPR checkbox copy.

Sophia K.: I'll add embed snippet and GDPR text by lunchtime. Suggested GDPR: "I agree to receive emails about Redwood Inference product updates. Unsubscribe anytime."

Tara L. (Legal): tweak to: "I consent to receive marketing communications from Redwood Inference. Review our Privacy Policy." Link to policy required.

Olivia P.: noted — will update copy.

Jason R.: Quick CTA language options: "See benchmarks" / "Join the launch webinar" / "Request a demo". Keep primary: "Join the launch webinar".

Emma D.: pushed hero drafts to the shared drive: /design/launch_assets/1766554321_hero_v1.png and _v2.png

Matt G.: attached benchmark sheet: https://internal/benchmarks/redwood_launch_176655.xlsx (contains test harness and configs). Use conservative phrasing as Tara said.

Olivia P.: Timeline check — we need final copy by tomorrow 3pm PT, design assets in by 11am, legal signoff by 2pm, and @publish-bot to schedule publish window. Is that feasible?

Tara L. (Legal): doable if we get final phrasing by 10:30.

Emma D.: can meet 11am asset deadline.

Matt G.: I'll finalize numbers and attach before noon.

Nate (SEO): I'll run final title/meta at 12:30 and send suggestions.

Sophia K.: I'll configure HubSpot and the form by 1pm, and share the embed.

Olivia P.: awesome. Last ask — can someone sanity-check the launch hero alt copy for accessibility? e.g., "Illustration: stylized server rack with latency waveform"

Emma D.: alt text approved.

publish-bot: Scheduling prereq checks passed. Ready to schedule once "publish_time" param is set.

Olivia P.: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate action items and drop the updated draft by 9:30am tomorrow. :raised_hands:

Matt G.: :thumbsup:

Jason R.: Will prepare the two intro variants for A/B.

Tara L. (Legal): I'll review once draft updates are in.

Sophia K.: I'll start HubSpot mapping now.

Olivia P.: Closing thread for now. Ping here if blockers.
